# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.gaps import gap_labels
from hourglass.models import Span

OPEN = Span(480, 1080)

class GapLabelTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_between_spans(self):
        worked = [Span(480, 720), Span(780, 1080)]
        labels = gap_labels(worked, OPEN)
        want = ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, want)

    def test_edges_and_overlaps(self):
        worked = [Span(600, 700), Span(650, 800)]
        self.assertEqual(gap_labels(worked, OPEN), [
            "gap 08:00-10:00 (120 min)",
            "gap 13:20-18:00 (280 min)"
        ])

    def test_nothing_worked(self):
        labels = gap_labels([], OPEN)
        want = ["gap 08:00-18:00 (600 min)"]
        self.assertEqual(labels, want)

    def test_full_coverage(self):
        self.assertEqual(gap_labels([OPEN], OPEN), [])

    def test_outside_opening_hours(self):
        for span in (Span(420, 600), Span(900, 1100)):
            with self.subTest(span=span):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    gap_labels([span], OPEN)
